_scaffold: Real docs/02-sitemap-and-navigation.md nav items are added as their pages are built. About, Resources and Contact are still missing (Phase 8), so they're intentionally left out rather than linking to pages that don't exist yet. The build-check diagnostic page is deliberately excluded from real navigation.
_structure: Desktop header (docs/13 header restructure, 2026-09-18): centered logo with primaryLeft/primaryRight flanking it; items with a `children` array render as a hover/click dropdown. Tablet/mobile (<1080px) replaces the horizontal nav with a fixed bottom tab bar (`tabBar`) plus a right-side "More" drawer (`more`) reached via the tab bar's last slot.
